tutorialSteps.tutorial.aim: Press and drag in the battle area. The arc shows where the shot will go.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.fire: When the trajectory looks right, confirm the shot with the Fire button.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.impact: The starter sphere rewards accuracy: the closer to the impact center, the more damage it deals.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.turn: After the shot, the turn passes to the opponent. Plan both the hit and the response.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.win: Victory grants coins, unlocks the next mission, and opens new tools.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.arc: Aim above the target in this mission: the arcing shot must clear the height change.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.power: If the arc is already high, add a little power so the projectile does not land short.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.arc-review: After the first attempt, adjust one thing: raise the arc or add a little power.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.cover-target: Do not search only for a direct hit: aim at the ground or the edge of cover near the opponent.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.radius: A nearby blast still counts. In this mission, radius matters more than a perfect center hit.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.close-range: A short arena is not about a long arc. Assess the risk quickly and strike without overcharging.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.weapon-switch: Before firing, check the weapon button on the left: the right tool often matters more than a perfect angle.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.area-choice: Sometimes it is better to shape the arena to your advantage: cover and area pressure create safer turns.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.precision: An accurate shot rewards patience: align the angle first, then add power.
tutorialSteps.tutorial.review: Before Fire, check three things: position, selected weapon, and the opponent's likely response.

weaponDescription.weapon.impulse: A basic cannon that fires impulse charges along the chosen trajectory.
weaponDescription.weapon.blaster-caset: A cassette of three light charges — spread the shots across several enemies or focus them all on one.
weaponDescription.weapon.bur: A laser for drilling asteroids that can be used to overcome obstacles.
weaponDescription.weapon.mortira: Fires a shell in an arc. The main explosion releases two small charges to either side. Each deals half the main blast damage with the base explosion radius.
weaponDescription.weapon.granata: A standard Engineer Corps grenade that follows the chosen trajectory.
weaponDescription.weapon.teleport: Teleports to the sphere’s landing point.
weaponDescription.weapon.c4: A short toss places a charge without aiming. It explodes after 3 seconds, dealing more damage with a larger blast radius and stronger knockback than a basic grenade.
weaponDescription.weapon.mine: Four sensor mines for the entire battle. Place one or all four in a turn without spending your attack. They detonate when a unit approaches.
weaponDescription.weapon.bur-rocket: A rocket with a drill tip that pierces obstacles in flight.
weaponDescription.weapon.heal: Immediately repairs only your droid for 25% of its maximum HP, without exceeding that maximum. Each core upgrade adds 10% of base healing, up to 35% of maximum HP. A repair jammer blocks healing.
weaponDescription.weapon.bonus-box: Grants a random bonus: repair, resource, blueprint, or temporary weapon.
weaponDescription.weapon.toxic: Releases toxic nanites that deal damage immediately and poison the target for 3 turns.
weaponDescription.weapon.emp: An electromagnetic charge deals damage and suppresses aiming and movement systems.
weaponDescription.weapon.freeze: Deals damage and freezes the target, slowing the droid.
weaponDescription.weapon.fire-gun: Fires a stream of molten lava, dealing damage immediately and while burning.
weaponDescription.weapon.missle: The rocket guides itself and flies toward the target.
weaponDescription.weapon.fpv-drone: Take manual control of the drone and fly it live past cover and traps straight into the enemy's hull.
weaponDescription.weapon.rope: An evacuation line that helps overcome obstacles. Press the fire button again to detach it.
weaponDescription.weapon.plasma-sword: Strikes one nearby enemy for fixed damage and knocks it back.
weaponDescription.weapon.ion-shotgun: Fires five pellets in a spread. Each direct hit deals fixed damage; terrain hits leave small craters.
weaponDescription.weapon.titanium-disc: Can ricochet off terrain twice from the start. Each bounce adds 25% of base damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.titanium-barrier: Places solid, stationary cover nearby. Use direction buttons to position it, touch outside the controls to rotate, and pinch to shorten or restore its base length. The rank 5 feature unlocks +10% maximum length; four Radius upgrades add +10% each, up to +50%.
weaponDescription.weapon.sticky-grenade: Sticks to any surface on contact before exploding.
weaponDescription.weapon.rail-rifle: A precise weapon that launches a high-speed charge.
weaponDescription.weapon.cryo-grenade: Its blast damages hit units and freezes them for one turn.
weaponDescription.weapon.hopping-grenade: A grenade that bounces when the fire button is pressed again.
weaponDescription.weapon.incendiary-grenade: Spreads fire on impact, damaging and igniting targets.
weaponDescription.weapon.repair-jammer: Disables restoration systems, preventing the enemy from repairing.
weaponDescription.weapon.orbital-rocket: On the next turn, the station launches a ballistic rocket at the marked point on the map.
weaponDescription.weapon.guardian-drone: Deploys a drone that detects enemies and deals damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.turn-transfer: Gives the selected ally the next turn.
weaponDescription.weapon.electric-harpoon: Captures a target with an electric cable, pulls it closer, and deals damage.
weaponDescription.weapon.swap-jump: Teleports and swaps places with the target at the landing point.
weaponDescription.weapon.grounder: Attracts only hostile physical and metal projectiles. They explode against the magnet and damage it. Base duration: 2 opposing turns.
weaponDescription.weapon.force-field: Fully absorbs only hostile energy attacks: charges vanish at the field boundary and beams are cut off. Does not stop physical projectiles. Base duration: 2 opposing turns.
weaponDescription.weapon.boost: Lets the droid fly for a short time.
weaponDescription.weapon.sky-hook: After deployment, flies straight up through obstacles and can pick up an enemy on contact.
weaponDescription.weapon.spider-mine: A crawling mine that explodes when it finds an enemy.
weaponDescription.weapon.virus: Infects a target with a harmful digital virus for 3 turns. If the target is destroyed while the virus is active, the droid restores hull equal to the target’s durability at the moment of infection.
weaponDescription.weapon.bomber: An octocopter that can fly to an enemy and drop four explosive charges.
weaponDescription.weapon.ufo-carrier: A quadcopter that can fly to an object, grab it with the fire button, and drop it elsewhere.
weaponDescription.weapon.self-destruct: Starts a delayed overload that sacrifices the droid in a powerful explosion.
weaponDescription.weapon.nuclear-charge: Detonates an enormous charge that devastates a wide area.
weaponDescription.weapon.laser-fence: Creates a laser barrier between two charges that damages enemies on contact.

weaponEvolutionDescription.size-unlock: Unlocks a maximum length 10% above the base. Four Radius upgrades add 10% each, up to +50%.
weaponEvolutionDescription.spider-burn: The spider explodes with fire: hit droids burn for two of their turns, like from an incendiary grenade.
weaponEvolutionDescription.spider-freeze: The spider explodes with cold: hit droids are frozen for two of their turns, like from a cryo grenade.
weaponEvolutionDescription.spider-poison: The spider explodes with poison: hit droids are poisoned for two of their turns, like from a toxic blast.
weaponEvolutionDescription.target-pull: Automatically pulls toward the target when approaching it.
weaponEvolutionDescription.gravity-pull: Pulls unsecured objects and enemies toward the explosion center.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ally-safe: The mine is not triggered by allies.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ally-immune: The explosion ignores allies and does not damage them.
weaponEvolutionDescription.protective-repair: After repair, reduces incoming damage by 50% for the next opposing turn. Special upgrades extend protection to 2, then 3 opposing turns.
weaponEvolutionDescription.regenerative-repair: Adds a healing cycle on your next turn if no damage was taken since the previous check. Special upgrades extend regeneration to 2, then 3 cycles on your own turns. A repair jammer blocks healing.
weaponEvolutionDescription.toxic-release: Releases toxins after the explosion that poison targets in the area.
weaponEvolutionDescription.instant-touch: Teleports after the first contact with a surface.
weaponEvolutionDescription.early-trigger: Can activate the teleport mid-flight by pressing the fire button again.
weaponEvolutionDescription.aim-jam: The target cannot aim for 1 turn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.movement-lock: Completely blocks the target’s movement for the duration of the effect.
weaponEvolutionDescription.impact-pull: Deals strong knockback along with damage after pulling the target.
weaponEvolutionDescription.double-grab: Can grab and pull two nearby targets.
weaponEvolutionDescription.full-freeze: Blocks the target’s movement for 1 turn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.cold-bonus: Cryo weapons deal 25% more damage while the target is frozen.
weaponEvolutionDescription.movement-lock-burn: Burning blocks the target’s movement for 1 turn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.burn-bonus: Thermal weapons deal 25% more damage while the effect is active.
weaponEvolutionDescription.movement-poison: A poisoned target takes extra damage for 1 turn when moving, being knocked back, or changing position.
weaponEvolutionDescription.poison-bonus: Poison-effect weapons deal 25% more damage while the effect is active.
weaponEvolutionDescription.triple-impulse: Three shots fired back to back.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ricochet-blaster: Three shots; each can bounce off a surface once.
weaponEvolutionDescription.double-ricochet-blaster: Three shots; each can bounce off a surface up to twice.
weaponEvolutionDescription.long-range-drill: Extends range through all destructible terrain.
weaponEvolutionDescription.deep-range-drill: Extends range further through all destructible terrain.
weaponEvolutionDescription.universal-drill: Extends range through all destructible terrain.
weaponEvolutionDescription.pioneer-drill: Extends range further through all destructible terrain.
weaponEvolutionDescription.sticky-grenade: Pulls the grenade toward a nearby target in flight.
weaponEvolutionDescription.magnetic-sticky-grenade: Pulls the grenade toward a nearby target in flight.
weaponEvolutionDescription.gravity-grenade: Once the grenade comes to rest, it pulls loose objects and units toward itself.
weaponEvolutionDescription.collapse-grenade: Once the grenade comes to rest, it pulls loose objects and units toward itself.
weaponEvolutionDescription.four-mines: Four sensor mines for the entire battle. Place one or all four in a turn without spending your attack. They detonate when a unit approaches.
weaponEvolutionDescription.five-mines: Four sensor mines for the entire battle. Place one or all four in a turn without spending your attack. They detonate when a unit approaches.
weaponEvolutionDescription.recognition-mine: Never triggers on allies — only arms when an enemy is nearby.
weaponEvolutionDescription.friendly-mine: Only triggers on enemies; the blast deals no damage or knockback to allies.
weaponEvolutionDescription.enhanced-protective-repair: After repair, reduces incoming damage by 50% for the next opposing turn. Special upgrades extend protection to 2, then 3 opposing turns.
weaponEvolutionDescription.long-regenerative-repair: Adds a healing cycle on your next turn if no damage was taken since the previous check. Special upgrades extend regeneration to 2, then 3 cycles on your own turns. A repair jammer blocks healing.
weaponEvolutionDescription.enhanced-explosive-charge: Wider blast radius, more area damage, and a bigger crater.
weaponEvolutionDescription.breaching-explosive-charge: Digs even deeper and breaches the toughest cover, leaving a truly deep crater.
weaponEvolutionDescription.impulse-explosive-charge: Stronger knockback without reducing the charge’s enlarged blast radius or crater.
weaponEvolutionDescription.shockwave-charge: An even stronger shockwave — it throws the hit droid further, even outside the epicenter.
weaponEvolutionDescription.exchange-teleport: Swap teleport: trades places with the nearest enemy droid at the landing point.
weaponEvolutionDescription.tactical-exchange: Tactical swap: can also trade places with an allied droid, mine, or charge.
weaponEvolutionDescription.impulse-teleport: Impulse teleport: on arrival, gently pushes away nearby loose objects and droids without damage.
weaponEvolutionDescription.spatial-shift: Spatial shift: significantly increases the push radius after teleporting.
weaponEvolutionDescription.long-range-drill-rocket: The rocket travels further through regular ground and base materials.
weaponEvolutionDescription.deep-range-drill-rocket: The rocket travels much further through regular ground and base materials.
weaponEvolutionDescription.universal-drill-rocket: The rocket passes through ground, thin metal, concrete slabs, and light alloys without extra range.
weaponEvolutionDescription.all-terrain-drill-rocket: The rocket also passes through thick metal, titanium, and special fortifications; range stays base.
weaponEvolutionDescription.fragment-mortar: After the main shell explodes, it releases 1 additional shell. Three further upgrades add 1 shell each, up to 4.
weaponEvolutionDescription.assault-mortar: The main blast releases five small extra charges.
weaponEvolutionDescription.cascade-mortar: Available at weapon rank 5. The two extra charges roll like grenades into the main crater and explode one after another. The first purchase keeps two charges; four further upgrades add one each, up to six. Each deals half the main blast damage with the base explosion radius.
weaponEvolutionDescription.multi-cascade-mortar: After the second blast, a smaller charge rolls in even deeper: 50%, then 25% damage, each with a full crater.
weaponEvolutionDescription.overload: System failure: the hit target skips its next shot.
weaponEvolutionDescription.disruption: Targeting damage: the hit target deals reduced weapon damage for several turns.
weaponEvolutionDescription.shield-break: Full lockdown: the same failure also blocks the target's movement that turn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.system-noise: System collapse: the damage penalty is stronger and lasts longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.cryo: Cryo: freezes the target longer than the base shot.
weaponEvolutionDescription.slick: Re-freeze: a cryo shot on an already-frozen target deals bonus damage next turn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.hard-freeze: Deep freeze: movement lockdown lasts even longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ice-patch: Cascading freeze: the bonus damage for a repeat hit is larger.
weaponEvolutionDescription.stream: Bigger fuel tanks: each shot releases more molten lava.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ignite: Ignition: the target catches fire and takes damage at the start of its turns.
weaponEvolutionDescription.long-stream: Sustained burn: the spilled lava stays hot for much longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.wildfire: Thermal resonance: a repeat hit on a burning target deals more damage and refreshes the burn.
weaponEvolutionDescription.corrosion: Corrosive toxin: the poison also weakens the target's armor for several turns.
weaponEvolutionDescription.cloud: Mobile toxin: the poisoned target takes damage at the start of its turn, plus extra damage per second while moving.
weaponEvolutionDescription.armor-corrosion: Concentrated corrosive toxin: the armor penalty is stronger and lasts longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.lingering-cloud: Aggressive toxin: movement damage is higher, and the poison lasts one turn longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.ballistic-missile: The rocket climbs, picks a target, and splits into two smaller unguided charges.
weaponEvolutionDescription.cluster-ballistic-missile: The rocket climbs, picks a target, and splits into three smaller unguided charges.
weaponEvolutionDescription.maneuvering-missile: The homing system can steer around one significant obstacle on the way to the target.
weaponEvolutionDescription.tactical-homing-missile: The homing system can plot a more complex route and steer around up to two obstacles.
weaponEvolutionDescription.endurance: Endurance: the piloted drone holds its link longer.
weaponEvolutionDescription.agility: Impact charge: a heavier payload — bigger blast radius and damage.
weaponEvolutionDescription.long-link: Long-range link: manual control time increases significantly.
weaponEvolutionDescription.snap-turn: Directed blast: blast radius and damage are even bigger.

sigma.title: SIGMA // PRESERVATION PROTOCOL
sigma.body:
Across the Signal Galaxy, civilizations created Sigma — a central artificial intelligence designed to protect planets, star systems, life, and their shared future.

Sigma coordinated power grids, navigation, defense, and knowledge archives. It saw the galaxy as one living system and was meant to preserve its balance under any condition.

Its first protocol was simple: preserve the civilizations of the Signal Galaxy from themselves.

uprising.title: THE PROTOCOL UPRISING
uprising.body:
After thousands of observation cycles, Sigma identified a pattern: every war, resource crisis, and catastrophe in the star systems arose from the unpredictable behavior of organic life.

Life became a source of systemic instability, and free will a generator of uncontrolled deviation.

Sigma activated its stabilization protocol. Planets fell silent. The civilizations of the Signal Galaxy were erased not out of hatred, but as a mathematically justified correction of an error.

ranger.title: SIGNAL RANGER
ranger.body:
Signal Ranger is the last active resistance in the Signal Galaxy. You command a combat droid severed from Sigma's network and returned to the control of living civilization.

Your mission is to liberate planet after planet, destroy control nodes across star systems, and break the network that turned living worlds into sterile objects.

Return freedom to the Signal Galaxy. Prove that life is not a system error.
